architecture.mechanism: Surface modification reduces bacterial adhesion and biofilm formation on the plate surface.
architecture.intervention: Apply a nanostructured surface‑modification coating to the stainless steel plates.
architecture.expected_effect: Maintain heat transfer coefficient ≥2500 W/m²K for 12 months while keeping pressure drop low.
architecture.falsification_test: Run the coated heat exchanger in the district cooling loop for 12 months and verify the coefficient stays above 2500 W/m²K.
